typography.strategy: High-contrast, technical futuristic feel. Wide display sans for headings and clean legible sans for body.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 and critical numbers/balances. tracking-tighter for H1.

body.usage: Use for descriptions, labels, and standard text.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-white
scale.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500

visual enhancers.borders: Use sharp or slightly rounded corners (max rounded-md). Rely on 1px solid borders (border-white/10) to define sections. Never use soft drop shadows, use colored glows.
visual enhancers.textures: Background should be very dark, almost void-like. Use subtle radial gradients in the background to highlight sections, e.g., a massive 20% opacity cyan radial glow behind the hero text.

grids.product_catalog: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6
grids.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Generous padding in sections.

layouts.header: Sticky top, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050507]/80, border-b border-white/10. Logo left, Nav center, User Wallet/Balance right.
layouts.hero: Min-h-[60vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center relative overflow-hidden. Add glowing radial backgrounds.
layouts.user_panel: Grid layout. Left sidebar or top tabs for navigation (Historial, Cargar Saldo). Main area displays big glowing Balance Card.
layouts.testimonials: Use react-fast-marquee. A single infinite scrolling row of sleek dark cards with neon borders containing user feedback.

motion.hover_states: Buttons and Cards must have strong hover states: scale up slightly (scale-105), intensify border color to a neon accent, and add a glow box-shadow.
motion.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion for subtle fade-in and slide-up of content when pages mount.
motion.interactions: Wallet balance deduction should animate if possible. Error states (insufficient balance) should shake slightly.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over neon backgrounds is black or dark gray. White text should only go on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='buy-button-item1').
accessibility.feedback: Use toast notifications (Sonner) for purchase success, insufficient balance errors, and balance load success.

media.treatment: Images in product cards should have a subtle dark overlay or be placed on pitch black backgrounds to match the tech/neon vibe.

3d libraries.usage: None strictly required. Keep it fast and 2D neon-focused.

image urls.description: Black and red/magenta light illustration. Great for a subtle background glow mask in the hero.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Generate `.js` and `.jsx` files, NOT `.tsx` files. Remove type annotations.
Set up a global Context or Zustand store for 'User' to handle login state, wallet balance, and purchase history. This is vital for the 'saldo interno' feature.

Implement the '1-2 clicks purchase' flow: From the product grid, clicking 'Comprar' immediately checks wallet balance. If balance >= price, deduct balance, add to history, show Success Toast. If not, show Error Toast with 'Cargar Saldo' button.
For the Testimonial section, use the 'react-fast-marquee' library to create a seamless auto-scrolling loop. Pause on hover.
The admin panel should be a simple protected route where an admin can add products (name, description, price, image url) to the global state/DB.
Inject tailwind glow effects into the configuration: extend colors and dropShadow in tailwind.config.js to include neon green, cyan, and magenta glows.
Use lucide-react icons heavily to reinforce the tech vibe (e.g., Wallet, Zap, History, User).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (like the header).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays if content scrolls beneath them. Ensure readability.
Enforce high contrast ratios. Do not rely solely on color to convey state (use icons and borders too).
Primary call-to-actions (Buy, Load Balance) must use the dominant neon color (e.g., Neon Green) with a distinct glow to pull attention.
Always generate JavaScript files (.js/.jsx). Do not output TypeScript.
